name: MetalHatsCats CBT Toolkit
relationship: public source corpus related to CBT Cards
publication_policy: The CBT Cards website publishes curated HTML pages from this corpus only after editorial and safety review. The full source corpus remains available as machine-readable data.
quality_notes: The source taxonomy distinguishes card, metaphor, and protocol records but does not encode clinical-review status.
The corpus contains CBT-adjacent techniques and labels in addition to core CBT concepts; a record should not be treated as clinical guidance solely because it appears in this dataset.
Protocol records require separate review before being republished as standalone health-adjacent web guidance.
Source records protocol-1 and protocol-8 share the title Burnout Recovery Protocol and should be reconciled before large-scale page generation.
